title: Google Jobs Scraper
description: Collect job listings from Google Jobs search results by keyword, location, or a Google Jobs URL. Returns job titles, companies, locations, salary ranges, posting dates, descriptions, qualifications, and application links.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: A Google Jobs search results URL. When supplied, it takes precedence over Keyword and Location, and its query and location parameters are used as provided.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Job search terms, such as 'software engineer' or 'product manager'. Ignored when Start URL is supplied.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional location to include in the Google Jobs query, such as 'New York, NY', 'London', or 'Remote'. Ignored when Start URL is supplied.

posted_date.title: Posted date
posted_date.description: Keep jobs posted within this window. Listings without a recognizable posting date are kept.

results_wanted.title: Maximum jobs
results_wanted.description: Stop after this many jobs have been saved.

max_pages.title: Maximum search requests
max_pages.description: Starting Google Jobs request budget. Each request returns up to 10 listings. If this is too low for results_wanted, the Actor raises the budget and logs the change.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: The default uses Apify's Google SERP proxy group. You can select another Apify group or provide custom proxy URLs.
